verified_facts.text: The resort sits on the banks of Dongqian Lake in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Ningbo Resort and Spa is situated on the banks of Dongqian Lake

verified_facts.text: The resort is about two and a half hours' drive from Shanghai.
verified_facts.excerpt: It is just 2-½ hours’ drive from Shanghai

verified_facts.text: The resort operates its own dining boat that cruises on Dongqian Lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: imagine gently cruising along the quaint Dongqian Lake and taking in majestic mountain views while enjoying delicious cuisine and superior service

verified_facts.text: The dining boats have a traditional dragon-boat exterior design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our two deluxe, First-class cruisers boast hi-tec and modern comforts, along with a traditional, dragon-boat exterior design.

verified_facts.text: Red, the resort's bar, was rebuilt from a 700-year-old classical temple palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Red was rebuilt from a 700 year old classical temple palace and retains the traditional Chinese red element

verified_facts.text: Red hosts the resort's vegetarian temple food feast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Red is also the carrier of the resort's vegetarian feast. The Temple Food of Red is another feature of Park Hyatt Ningbo Resort and Spa.

verified_facts.text: On weekend evenings the Tea House becomes a Chinese bistro serving Chinese cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each weekend evening, the tea house undergoes a stunning metamorphosis into an elegant Chinese bistro

verified_facts.text: At Seafood House, guests choose their own catch and a preparation style ranging from Ningbo favourites to Zhejiang flavours.
verified_facts.excerpt: allowing guests to choose their own “catch” from a series of preparation styles ranging from local Ningbo favourites to nearby Zhejiang flavours

verified_facts.text: Seafood House has pavilion-style private dining rooms set around an outdoor garden and courtyard along the canal.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set in a traditional Chinese noble family surrounding along the canal, with outdoor garden and courtyard

verified_facts.text: Dining Room serves a lake-view brunch on weekends featuring lobster prepared in a variety of ways.
verified_facts.excerpt: The lake view brunch is available on each weekend, presenting the ultimate brunch experience featuring lobster freshly prepared in a variety of ways

verified_facts.text: The resort has a temperature-controlled indoor pool in traditional Chinese architecture and an outdoor infinity pool with lake views.
verified_facts.excerpt: The luxurious temperature-controlled indoor pool in traditional Chinese architecture, offers guests tranquil outdoor terrace, and outdoor infinity pool with panoramic lake view.

verified_facts.text: Yue Hu Spa offers treatments from facials to stone therapy.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Yue Hu Spa will leave you feeling rejuvenated after a variety of relaxing treatments, from facials to stone therapy

verified_facts.text: The Fitness Pavilion overlooks Dong Qian Lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fitness Pavilion overlooking Dong Qian Lake features high-end Technogym cardio equipment

verified_facts.text: Spa Suites include a Chinese-style courtyard with an outdoor whirlpool, steam room and sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: The suite includes a Chinese-style courtyard, outdoor whirlpool, steam room, sauna, and other spa facilities.

verified_facts.text: Village Area rooms are in two-story or single-story buildings modelled on local houses near Dongqian Lake.
verified_facts.excerpt: these accommodations include either two-story small buildings or single-story units, incorporating 45 square meters of Chinese-style residential elements

verified_facts.text: Each room has floor-to-ceiling views of the lake or the mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each room offers stunning floor-to-ceiling views of the lake or the mountains, and select suites feature balconies.

verified_facts.text: The resort's design follows the concept of modern people living in a village.
verified_facts.excerpt: The design of the hotel’s infrastructure is in full compliance with the concept of “modern people living in a village”.

verified_facts.text: Dogs up to 15 kilograms are welcome, in garden-view rooms, for a nightly pet fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Your traveling canine companions are welcome at Park Hyatt Ningbo Resort and Spa. Dogs must be housebroken and up to date on vaccinations. We reserve our garden-view rooms for your furry friends.

verified_facts.text: The Tea House hosts Kunqu performances from Thursday to Saturday.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Kunqu Performance

    - Thu - Sat

verified_facts.text: Self-parking at the hotel is free.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Self-Parking

Free

verified_facts.text: Ningbo Lishe International Airport is 21.4 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt:
Ningbo Lishe International Airport (NGB)

21.4 Kilometers

verified_facts.text: Guests can cycle around Dongqian Lake and explore its temples.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spend your day around Dongqian Lake: Cycle around the area, explore its many temples or sample local cuisine nearby.

verified_facts.text: Tianyi Pavilion is 15.12 kilometers from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt:

15.12 Kilometers away
